`big.jpg` (8000x6000 noise at Q=100, over 20 MB) is generated by the test at run time and is not stored here.

The first DNG tried, Samsung SM-G973U (raw.pixls.us file 3839, 8-bit CFA), is rejected by LibRaw 0.21.4 ("Unsupported file format"), so it was not used.
